faqs.title: faqs
faqs.subtitle: Everything  you  need to know about shopping, materials, nationwide delivery, and jewellery care at RAHA.
faqs.bodyHtml:
1. Do you have a physical store?

Not just yet! We're currently an online-only brand. Shop your favourite pieces right here, from the comfort of your home.

2. What materials are used in your jewellery?

We carefully select our jewellery for its style, quality and affordability. Material details are mentioned in individual product descriptions. Most of our pieces are stainless steel and hypoallergenic because we care for you.

10. How can I contact RAHA?

We're just a message away! Reach us through Instagram (@rahajewels.co), WhatsApp (0326 0870876) or our gmail (contact.rahaofficial@gmail.com). ♡
